summary: Learn partnership and ecosystem strategy with stakeholder mapping, governance, and partner scorecards. Build practical tools and report with confidence.
lede: Partnership and ecosystem strategy helps partnership, alliance, and business development professionals structure collaboration across organizations with clear roles and shared measures. The course covers ecosystem mapping, partner portfolio assessment, scorecard design, negotiation planning, and governance charter development. Learners also practice reporting progress and assessing partnership risks to coordinate stakeholder contributions and communicate performance.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage, influence, or report on partnerships and ecosystem relationships. It fits you if your work involves external stakeholders, collaborative delivery, joint value creation, or governance across multiple organizations. Partnership managers coordinating external collaboration and governance. Alliance managers structuring joint value and shared accountability. Business development managers building strategic partner pipelines. Ecosystem strategists mapping multi-actor collaboration models. Strategic account managers managing partner relationships and renewals. Supplier relationship managers monitoring performance and escalation paths. Corporate affairs leads aligning stakeholders around partnership priorities. Innovation managers working with technology and research partners. Cross-functional program managers coordinating partner delivery workflows. Commercial directors reporting ecosystem performance to executives.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop and familiarity with spreadsheet and presentation tools. If possible, prepare one live partnership challenge, one stakeholder list, and one example of a current partner report, dashboard, or agreement summary for use in exercises.
